note: UI overhaul lane W4 (production, construction, trade, logistics, military and intelligence windows): emblems for the icon sprites whose sockets were empty. The same painted style as the attached small interface icon sheet: each item one free-standing object or emblem in aged bronze, dark iron, oak and enamel, lit from the upper left, crisp silhouette that reads at 24 pixels, no plaque or frame behind it unless the item names one. Rows 1 to 3 and rows 4 to 6 are matched sets: the same small object repeated once, twice or three times, each set coloured in one of five enamel tints, so that the tints and the counts read at 22 by 18 pixels. Keep every item the same height.
